tasks.short: Oversee recreation facilities purchase, planning and upkeep

steps.what: Inspect facilities and agree needs, scope and priorities with stakeholders
Compile purchase, design, construction and upkeep records for review
Review designs and progress, resolve issues and oversee contractors and upkeep

tasks.design: Use native linked views in {PROJECT} and {DOCS} to assemble current facility records without repeatedly rebuilding a pack. Keep inspections, design choices, purchase oversight and contractor discussions with the worker and qualified specialists.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewers collect versions from several project folders before discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views can group linked records by facility and milestone.
tasks.still_hard: Accessibility, safe construction and competing recreation needs need expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Represent participants' practical needs during technical and budget discussions.
tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly; the worker retains existing oversight authority.

reach.learn: Life-cycle cost and accessible design trade-offs

evidence.claim: Linked project views and the proposed pack-assembly saving are an E1 design scenario; the digest has no facility-oversight case.

assumptions: Boundary is recreation-worker oversight, not designers', purchasers' or contractors' execution labour.

Worker records facility identifier, needs, priority and observation date in s1 with all capture retained. Existing project record producers are project coordinator for milestone and owner, purchaser for purchase reference and status, and designer for drawing identifier and revision; their unchanged capture is outside this boundary and no new reporting is requested.
Worker links and verifies those records in retained s2 time; missing dates, versions or links require manual collection, not inferred progress.
Test native linked views before code. Two focal hours cover ongoing link and view upkeep.
unknowns: Worker's delegated spending and design authority
research_questions: Can linked views halve assembly time while exposing stale or missing revisions?

already_counted.description: Pack selection, missing-record collection and version checks

incremental.description: Maintain facility links and view configuration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 minus 2 upkeep gives net=8. High requires coherent project records; low assumes collection still consumes 18 of the baseline 20 assembly hours. All 80 oversight hours remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Encourage participants' activities and leadership through group discussions

steps.what: Encourage participants to develop activities and leadership through inclusive group discussions

tasks.design: Keep group encouragement and discussion with the worker. Existing facilitation guidance in {DOCS} supports practice, but the task does not supply a separate preparation or paperwork baseline to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation grows through trust and responsive facilitation.
tasks.enabler_now: No proven change to the live discussion is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Quiet participants, group conflict and uneven confidence need sensitive responses.
tasks.human_edge: Give participants space to lead without taking ownership away from them.
tasks.altitude: The worker retains the same facilitation role.

reach.learn: How to distribute speaking and decision opportunities

evidence.claim: Live encouragement is retained in full; no measured time saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is the group discussion and encouragement, excluding separate activity planning.
No structured input or automated judgement is introduced.
No software change is proposed, so native configuration and incremental upkeep are unnecessary.
research_questions: Which facilitation approaches allow quieter participants to propose activities?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no upkeep give net=0; discussion time remains intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with community and agency personnel on balanced programs

steps.what: Assemble current program proposals and constraints for collaboration
Meet and collaborate with agency and community personnel on balanced recreational programs
Confirm agreed actions and reconcile program balance with participant needs

tasks.design: Configure a reusable discussion-pack view over approved proposals in {DOCS} and existing dates in {CALENDAR}. Keep collaboration, program balance and confirmation of commitments with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Workers repeatedly gather the same proposal versions before partner meetings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and calendar views can reuse existing records.
tasks.still_hard: Partners may disagree about access, budget and which groups are underserved.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a program that reflects different participants' needs.
tasks.altitude: A little preparation time becomes available without expanding decision rights.

reach.learn: How to identify gaps across participant groups

evidence.claim: Reusing linked proposals for a meeting pack is a conditional E1 design, not a measured recreation case.

assumptions: Boundary is this worker's preparation, collaboration and confirmation; partner attendance and proposal authorship remain outside the focal denominator.

Existing proposal authors produce title, owner, target group, activity, version and proposed date; calendar owners produce existing dates. No additional structured submission is required. Worker selects, links and checks these fields in retained s1 time, including manual collection of missing material.
Native document and calendar views precede custom development. No automated decision about program balance is made.
research_questions: Does a linked pack remove half the assembly time without reducing partner discussion?

already_counted.description: Pack selection, version checking and missing-material collection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 minus 2 upkeep gives net=8. High assumes reusable proposal links; low assumes only 2 hours of assembly saving. Collaboration and confirmation retain 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide entertainment and set up decorations and equipment

steps.what: Arrange suitable entertainment and coordinate practical requirements
Set up decorations and equipment and check safe access and operation

tasks.design: Keep entertainment arrangements and physical setup with the worker. An existing checklist in {DOCS} may support safe setup but earns no labour reduction by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work involves real people, physical objects and venue conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated automation of this setup is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment faults, accessibility and last-minute changes require on-site responses.
tasks.human_edge: Create an inviting space while noticing practical hazards.
tasks.altitude: The worker retains the same setup and coordination duties.

reach.learn: Safe equipment placement and accessible routes

evidence.claim: No physical setup saving is established; both arrangement and setup time are retained.

assumptions: Boundary is worker arrangement and setup; entertainers' performance time is outside it.
No structured input or new automated step is introduced.
No system implementation or new checklist programme is proposed; native configuration and incremental upkeep are zero.
research_questions: Which setup tasks require specialist technicians rather than recreation staff?

already_counted.description: All entertainment coordination and setup retained

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give net=0. No administrative baseline is added to physical setup.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Project and collaboration packs take less assembly; live facilitation, oversight and setup remain central.
reach: Recreation supervisor: evaluate coverage and facility priorities
role.ambitious_version: Support participant-led activities with coherent facilities and partner programs while preserving personal encouragement.
